title: Focus order jumps from header to footer, skipping the form
description: Swiping right with VoiceOver on the checkout screen moves focus from the page title straight to the footer nav, skipping the shipping-address fields entirely. Users cannot reach the form with the screen reader.
location: Checkout > Shipping step, after the 'Shipping address' heading
remediation: Fix the DOM/accessibility order so the address fields fall between the heading and the footer, or set an explicit accessibility order.

title: Toast confirmation is not announced
description: After saving profile changes, a green 'Saved' toast appears for 3s but TalkBack says nothing, so screen-reader users get no confirmation the action succeeded.
remediation: Expose the toast container as a polite live region (accessibilityLiveRegion="polite" / role="status").

title: Custom dropdown not operable by keyboard
description: The country selector opens on click but cannot be opened or navigated with the keyboard (Enter/Space/Arrow keys do nothing), and it is not focusable via Tab.
remediation: Make the trigger focusable (tabindex=0), add role=combobox/listbox semantics, and wire Enter/Space/Arrow/Escape handling.

title: Error state shown by red border only
description: Invalid form fields are indicated only by a red border with no text or icon, so the error is not perceivable to color-blind users or screen readers.
remediation: Add an associated text error message and an icon; link it to the field with aria-describedby.
